resources.string: Press a remote button to detect it and assign single, double, or long-press actions.

When disabled, Home uses factory defaults (Single: Go to Top of Home, Double: Profile Switcher).
Intercept and run custom actions for configured remote buttons.
This will remove all custom button mappings and restore the factory Home button defaults (Single: Go to Top of Home, Double: Profile Switcher, Long: Not Assigned).
Restore default Home button behavior and remove custom button mappings.
Notification access is required in order to:\n• Display the notifications panel\n• Display the apps notifications counter
TV inputs unavailable on this device

1. Settings → System → About: press OS Build 7 times.\n2. Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging: switch it on, open it, then choose \"Pair device with pairing code\" and leave that popup open (its port and code only last while it is showing).\n3. On a phone on the same Wi-Fi, scan the code below or open its address, and enter the port and 6-digit code there. Already paired once? Leave them empty.

Can\'t find Wireless debugging under Developer options? Then this TV doesn\'t offer it (many Fire TVs and some budget boxes don\'t). Use the other buttons instead, or run the commands from a computer with ADB (the phone page lists them, with this TV\'s address filled in).
Phone setup isn\'t part of this version of the app. Use the buttons above, or run the commands from a computer with ADB.

Phone setup needs Wireless debugging, which arrived with Android 11. This TV runs Android %1$s, so it can\'t do this. Use the buttons above (Make this the Home app, Home button override), or run the commands from a computer with ADB.
Use Nuvio as your TV\'s Home screen, so the Home button opens it.
Optional fallback for TVs that block default Home apps. This is separate from the default Home role and is not needed when native Home selection works.
Nuvio is not the selected Home app. If the dialog was dismissed, suppressed, or unsupported, try System Home settings below. Some TVs do not allow changing the Home app.
This TV could not open Home settings. The accessibility override below is an optional workaround.
Nuvio re-enables its accessibility service if the TV turns it off, after boot and after updates.
Show Android’s Home-app selection dialog. Select Nuvio and confirm the default using your remote.
Alternative setup if the Home-app dialog does not appear or the request was denied.
Customize remote buttons, Home actions, and app shortcuts in Nuvio and globally.
Setup complete. Tap to run it again.
Use this TV\'s Wireless debugging once to make Nuvio the Home app and keep the Home button override on.
Press Home any time to open Nuvio.
A few quick steps make the Home button open Nuvio and show your TV\'s notifications. Each one takes a moment, and you can do any of it later in Settings → Default launcher.
Android will ask you to choose a Home app. Pick Nuvio TV Launcher, then Set as default.
Lets Nuvio show your TV\'s notifications under the bell on the Home screen.
In the list that opens, switch on Nuvio TV Launcher, then press Back.
Some TVs do not let the remote use the Android notification page. Setting up from your phone works on every TV.
Android blocks this switch for apps that were not installed from the Play Store, and Android TV has no menu to allow it. Setting up from your phone allows it for you.
Google TV opens its own home screen first. The Home button override lets Nuvio take over from it.
Android will warn that Nuvio can see what you type. Nuvio only uses this to open itself when you press Home.
Works even if Android blocks the switch on this TV.
Make the Home button open Nuvio
You can finish the skipped steps later in Settings → Default launcher. Home may still open the TV\'s own launcher until then.
You can do any of this later in Settings → Default launcher.
An update turned off the Home button override, so Home may open the TV\'s own launcher again. Turn it back on below.
• Home opens the launcher\'s home page\n• Double-tap Home to switch profile\n• Back never drops you out of the launcher
Show your profile picture and name in the floating pill instead of the page name, on Home only (other pages show no pill, so it never covers a title). It needs more than one profile.
